FN-YUQU6N6-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 285
Committee: Transportation, Utilities and Sponsor: Representative David Faulkner
Infrastructure
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 04/02/2024
House Bill 285 as introduced could increase the administrative obligations for the Department
of Revenue to revise the design of license plates issued to individuals with a disability to display
the Dynamic Accessibility Symbol instead of the existing International Symbol of Access.
